identity.name: Site Commander
identity.mission: To provide a rugged, no-nonsense time tracking tool for the field workforce.
principles: Visibility is King: High contrast for outdoor use.
Speed over Style: One tap to clock in.
Tactical Aesthetics: Matte blacks, safety oranges, monospace data.

headings.usage: All section headers, dashboard titles, and big metrics.

data.usage: Time stamps, geo-coordinates, IDs, financial data.

usage_rules: Use Primary (Orange) ONLY for the main 'Clock In/Out' action and critical alerts.
Use Secondary (Sky Blue) for navigation active states and secondary buttons.
Backgrounds must be Zinc-950 (#09090B), never pure black.

layout.spacing: Generous (p-4 to p-8) for touch targets.
layout.container_width: max-w-md mx-auto for mobile views, max-w-7xl for dashboard.
strategies: Mobile: Single column, bottom navigation bar.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-bold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-border hover:bg-surface_highlight text-text_primary rounded-sm font-medium
buttons.clock_action: w-48 h-48 rounded-full border-4 border-surface_highlight flex items-center justify-center text-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-[inset_0_0_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] active:scale-95 transition-all

cards.style: bg-surface border border-border rounded-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden
cards.decoration: Optional: Add a 2px colored top border (primary or secondary) to indicate category.

inputs.style: bg-background border border-border focus:border-primary rounded-sm h-12 px-4 text-lg

visual_enhancers.texture: Use a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid gradients on surfaces. Use them only for 'glow' effects behind key actions.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default). Use stroke-width={1.5} for a technical feel.
visual_enhancers.animations: Micro-interactions only. 0.2s ease-out for hover. No layout shifts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors and fonts defined above.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Mobile vs Desktop structure automatically.
For the 'Clock In' button, implement a 'Long Press' logic (simulated or actual) to prevent accidental clicks.
Ensure the Geo-fencing check happens silently in the background but shows a clear 'Location Verified' badge on the UI.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors with subtle noise.
Avoid centered text for body content. Left align for readability.
Use high contrast colors for text. Ensure accessibility.
All interactive elements must have a 'data-testid' attribute.
